description: Extract canonical generic status, step, HTTP/error metadata, and report envelope types with compatible email exports and shared-interface mirrors.
Extract the timed runStep wrapper with injectable domain error and recommendation policy; preserve returned data and HTTP metadata.
Extract the existing overall-status fold without changing email pass/warn/fail/skip semantics.
Extract Graph failure classification and request-id/client-request-id capture for shared use.
Move MicrosoftGraphAdapter diagnostics onto shared primitives without changing its report, recommendations, or optional live-subscription behavior.
Define Entra connection/client report, summary, client result, structured recommendation, action, and support-bundle contracts.
Implement stable step IDs, ordered execution, timed results, and dependency-aware blocked-by skips while preserving independent checks.
Deduplicate recommendations by code/context/action and order by severity without merging distinct customer consent actions.
Populate connection type/status/profile/partner identity/token expiry/discovery count/mapping count and fold completed client outcomes into report status.
Share requireEntraAccess read-policy evaluation to report edition, both tier grants, and RBAC safely without weakening authentication or client-portal denial.
Preserve safe structured readiness failures through routes/actions, including Pro-tier explanation and CE edition-unavailable behavior.
Implement connection_row with active-row detection and connection type/status/timestamps/stored validation snapshot without updating it.
Implement app_registration_binding with distinct binding/profile/archive/capability outcomes and profile name.
Implement client_secret_present using the tenant secret provider, non-empty check, and last-four fingerprint only.
Report stored secret expiry if available, warn within 30 days, fail expired secrets, and otherwise show the specified unknown-expiry explanation.
Share server-side Entra callback URL resolution across connect, setup metadata, and diagnostics, preserving intended URL precedence without client reconstruction.
Implement informational expected_app_registration_values with exact callback, delegated scopes, multi-tenant requirement, available bound app id, and copy actions without Graph application reads.
Implement read-only Temporal namespace/task-queue/worker-poller checks with explicit unreachable or unknown-evidence results and no probe workflow.
Describe the existing Entra schedule, compare enablement/interval, report next fire time, and warn on drift or sync-off without reconciliation.
Skip credential-dependent checks for missing readiness prerequisites while continuing expected-value information and independent sync health.
Implement token_set_present with access/refresh fingerprints and expiry presence; missing refresh fails, refreshable access/expiry gaps warn.
Implement token_refresh against common with current bound credentials and only the existing refreshed-token persistence exception.
Preserve safe Microsoft OAuth error, suberror, AADSTS code, and correlation metadata through token refresh operator errors.
Decode token claims without signature verification and report tid, account, appid, aud, and expiry with clear opaque-token handling.
Warn separately for missing ManagedTenants.Read.All and Directory.Read.All with consent-then-reconnect remedies.
Fail token_claims when minted appid differs from the bound application and skip dependent Graph checks.
Implement graph_me baseline GET with shared HTTP/Graph error metadata.
Implement managed_tenants_endpoint using entraDirectProbeEndpoint with distinct 400 endpoint fault, 401 token rejection, and 403 consent remedies.
Reuse full managed-tenant pagination/normalization with the refreshed token and report count plus at most ten display names.
Warn on zero Direct managed tenants with Lighthouse onboarding and active GDAP explanation.
Compare live discovery with confirmed mappings, warn for missing mapped tenants, and count unmapped discovered tenants without persistence.
Honor Graph/login emulator endpoint overrides and self-tenant smoke mode throughout Direct connection and client reads.
Classify AADSTS7000222/700016/65001/50076/50079/70000/90002/50020, invalid_client, invalid_grant, consent_required, and network failures with specific-code precedence.
Give customer-context consent, account, Conditional Access, and app/service-principal remedies distinct from partner reconnect advice.
Generate validated customer adminconsent URLs using managed tenant id and bound application client id, with copy/open actions and no secrets.
Classify customer users/groups 403 as delegated directory-role/GDAP failure and retain Graph request-id.
Decode safe stored/nested Temporal errors and apply the same OAuth classifier to historical AADSTS text.
Resolve selected confirmed mappings inside the authenticated tenant; omitted ids select all, empty ids select none, and foreign/unmapped ids are rejected.
Execute ordered steps per client with at most three clients in flight and independent outcomes across clients.
Implement tenant_token_mint and reuse one token for normal reads; preserve rotated refresh-token semantics without replacing partner access-token state.
Implement one-item users_read and retain the first user id internally for membership diagnostics; empty users does not fail access.
Implement one-item groups_read independently when the tenant token is usable.
Resolve the configured entitlement group, report displayName/securityEnabled, and distinguish deleted and non-security groups.
Probe checkMemberGroups read-only for the first sampled user, retaining group resolution when membership must skip for no user.
Skip entitlement checks when unconfigured and user_yield_preview when not requested, with clear reasons.
Reuse listUsersForTenant and the existing pure filter/settings logic for optional total/included/excluded-by-reason counts without calling writing preflight helpers.
Warn when a non-empty directory is entirely excluded and distinguish a genuinely empty directory.
Expose narrow adapter read/paging/token-context seams needed for diagnostics without changing sync behavior or losing error metadata.
Return per-client names/tenant display names/steps/status/remedy and count each result once as ok, need consent, conditional access, missing role, or other.
Implement cipp_credentials_present with sanitized base URL and API-token fingerprint, without Direct credential requirements.
Implement cipp_reachable using the existing three candidate endpoints, preserving fallback order and attempted/answering endpoint evidence.
Distinguish CIPP DNS, TLS, timeout, and HTTP failures without exposing request secrets.
Attribute reachable 401/403 to cipp_auth with the exact CIPP API-key rotation explanation, avoiding duplicate failure cascades.
Reuse successful CIPP tenant-list normalization to report count and at most ten display names, with CIPP-specific zero-list warning.
Implement cipp_mappings_vs_list warnings and unmapped count from confirmed tenant-scoped mappings.
Implement per_tenant_users with a bounded one-page CIPP adapter read for each selected client.
Support opt-in full CIPP user yield using the shared exclusion counter and the same no-write boundary.
Implement last_runs for five runs with trigger/status/duration and created/linked/updated/ambiguous/inactivated totals, including no-history presentation.
Warn for two consecutive real failed/partial syncs using notification-rule semantics, excluding dry runs from health conclusions.
Implement per_tenant_last_result from the latest actual sync and resolve failed mappings to client names with safe errors.
Cross-reference historical tenant failures with client diagnostics using identities and timestamps without presenting stale failures as current.
Implement reconciliation_queue count/oldest age and a review-queue recommendation when open items exist.
Expose runEntraConnectionDiagnostics through withAuth and the EE read guard, returning one connection report with no client fan-out.
Expose runEntraClientAccessDiagnostics with optional selected client ids and yield flag plus continuation response types.
Wire diagnostics EE routes, base-server delegators, packages/ee CE stubs, and integrations EE/OSS route entries.
Use tenantDb-scoped reads/joins for connections, profiles, mappings, settings, clients, history, and queue; derive tenant/user only from authentication.
Return authenticated expiring job/continuation state and bounded incremental client results instead of one request for all clients.
Bind continuations to user/tenant/selection/options and revalidate access, mapping, and connection context for every batch; reject tampering/expiry.
Bound external requests and large-directory preview pages; preserve completed clients and report unfinished work rather than a false completed pass.
Keep progress request-driven without persistent jobs, background promises, Temporal workflows, or DB/secret-store progress writes.
Prevent diagnostics from mutating connection verdicts, discovery, settings, mappings, contacts, sync history, queue, or schedules; allow only existing OAuth rotation writes.
Build EntraDiagnosticsDialog with standard Dialog/Badge/DataTable/Button controls, overall badge, summary grid, and expandable ordered steps.
Open the same dialog from Connection beside Validate and unhealthy Overview attention entries.
Render HTTP/error/correlation metadata, blocked reasons, informational expected values, and severity-ordered remediation actions.
Default client picker to all confirmed mappings, default yield off, require confirmation above 20, and prevent an empty selection from starting all clients.
Render client and tenant display names rather than GUIDs in table rows, with status/remedy and expanded identity/step details.
Accumulate completed client results and counts during continuations, show running/partial/failure states, stop after close, and prevent duplicate starts.
Offer copy/open/navigate actions for expected values, customer consent, Microsoft app settings, connection remediation, and review queue.
Serialize server-side support reports with only secret/token fingerprints and scrub nested errors/headers/URLs; always retain Graph request IDs.
Default exports to redacted identifiers and allow explicit includeIdentifiers exports without ever including full secrets/tokens.
Provide Copy support bundle and Download JSON from the same non-recursive serializer for available connection/client results.
Localize diagnostics strings under msp/admin integrations.entra.diagnostics.*, including stable step titles, remedies, status, confirmation, and blocked reasons.
Use theme-aware standard controls, unique interaction IDs, accessible status/progress labels, and the standard sticky dialog footer.
Add or reuse Graph emulator scenarios for healthy runs, partner consent, per-client consent/role errors, empty discovery, and expired client secret.
Extend the Entra guide with diagnostics flows/layers and consolidate AADSTS remediation into one table while preserving existing doc contracts.
Add an nm-store user documentation page for Run diagnostics, client results, and remediation using the business-documentation workflow and sanitized screenshots.
Record dev-stack emulator smoke evidence for connection/client scopes, one green run, and at least two distinct failure runs with screenshots.
